labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removal of support for SHA-1 Signer signatures means existing signed data from pre-3.1 Django may fail to validate after upgrade.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing SHA-1 dumps() signature support in loads() can cause previously signed values to fail verification after upgrade.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing support for pre-3.1 SHA-1 user sessions can log out or break sessions still stored with that algorithm.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The get_response argument is now required and no longer accepts None, so custom MiddlewareMixin subclasses passing None will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing the providing_args argument from Signal breaks any code that passes it when creating signals.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The length argument of get_random_string() is now required, so calls that omit it will raise errors.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing the list message for ModelMultipleChoiceField changes error message behavior and may break code or tests relying on it.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Support for raw column aliases in order_by() is removed, so existing queries using them will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: NullBooleanField is removed for models, so models using it must be migrated to BooleanField with null=True or similar.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: django.conf.urls.url() is removed, so URLconfs importing it must switch to re_path() or path().

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The contrib.postgres JSONField model field is removed, so models using it must be migrated to models.JSONField.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: KeyTransform and KeyTextTransform in contrib.postgres.fields.jsonb are removed, so imports and usages will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The contrib.postgres forms JSONField is removed, so forms importing it must switch to forms.JSONField.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The ifequal and ifnotequal template tags are removed, so templates using them will fail to render and need rewriting with if.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing the DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM setting means projects relying on it must migrate to the new hashing configuration.
